narr: A broad ridge of high pressure was present over the eastern CONUS, with a warm, humid airmass in place over northern OH. PWAT values were near 1.9 and MLCAPE values ranged from 1000-2000 j/kg. Steering flow was minimal, which allowed for slow moving thunderstorms. A single thunderstorm developed over Warren and remained stationary for nearly an hour, before an upstream thunderstorm over Portage County moved east across the Warren area. Radar estimated 2 to 3 of rainfall over northeast Warren over a 2 to 3 hour period, which led to excessive runoff and flash flooding.
ev: Several dozen reports of flooded roadways, water in basements of homes, and people driving into flooded roadways.
